operation: On the v2 backing at the G4b-2d tip: a seeded Show with Clips Outgoing (0+4000) and Incoming (4000+4000) at a Cut. Select Outgoing, open Add to Show; the 'Transition to Incoming' item is enabled (first capture). Choose it; the Choose Layer Transition palette opens (second capture, duration set to 1 s). Press Use Crossfade Transition (third capture). The fourth capture renders the stored v2 record (GET /api/shows) from the same run: a new 1000 ms live-live crossfade clip-out -> clip-in, with clip-in shifted from 4000 to 5000. The 2000 ms crossfade present before and after is the fixture's Scene-boundary Transition.
